c2_bad.why: Prescribes a hub-and-spoke home with 'account balance/status as the single focal element' and onboarding illustration. Field Inspect is a top-bar checklist/defect-form app with no hub, no account, no illustration, and the task changes one status banner. Chosen on lexical 0.008 with the explicit note 'no record matched the wording' - it should have been dropped rather than promoted to the only core record.
Keyboard types, autofill hints and IME insets are unrelated to a sync-status indicator. Selected only to satisfy 'required coverage: component'.
Safe-area insets and home-indicator clearance are true of any mobile screen and say nothing about what a spinner should report. Pure concern-filling ('recommended coverage: adaptive').
